description: This file defines API endpoints for managing blog posts, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting posts, and managing post versions. It uses FastAPI framework with SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions, and includes authorization checks.

methods.name: ensure_owner(post: Post, user: User)
methods.description: Checks if the user is authorized to modify or access the specified post, raising an HTTP 403 error if not.

methods.name: list_posts(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns a list of posts owned by the current user, or all posts if the user is an admin.

methods.name: create_post(post_in: PostCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new post and its initial version, then returns the created post.

methods.name: get_post(post_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a single post by ID, verifying ownership.

methods.name: update_post(post_id: int, post_in: PostUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates an existing post’s fields, increments its version, and adds a new post version record.

methods.name: delete_post(post_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a post and its versions after verifying ownership.

methods.name: list_versions(post_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all versions of a specific post.

methods.name: get_version(post_id: int, version_number: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific version of a post.
